subtitle: 國中程度引導式短文：回答三個問題，介紹你將來想做的工作
task: Write a short passage of 60–100 words about your dream job. Your passage should answer these questions: (1) What do you want to be in the future? (2) Why do you want to do this job? (3) What can you do now to get ready for it?
taskZh: 寫一篇 60–100 字的英文短文，介紹你將來想做的工作。短文要回答三個問題：(1) 你將來想做什麼工作？(2) 你為什麼想做這份工作？(3) 你現在可以做些什麼來準備？
focus: 內容：三個問題都要回答到
文法：現在式、過去式、未來的說法用得正確
連接詞：用 and、since、to 讓句子連貫
拼字與標點：句首大寫、句尾加句點

en: In the future, I want to be an animal doctor. I have loved animals since I was a little child. Two years ago, my dog Lucky got very sick. The doctor took good care of him, and he got better in a week. From then on, I wanted to help animals, too. To get ready for this job, I study science hard at school. I also help at an animal shelter on Saturdays. I hope my dream will come true one day.
zh: 將來，我想當一名獸醫。我從小就很喜歡動物。兩年前，我的狗 Lucky 生了重病。獸醫細心地照顧牠，一個星期後牠就好轉了。從那時起，我也想幫助動物。為了準備這份工作，我在學校認真讀自然科學。我每個星期六也會到動物收容所幫忙。我希望有一天能實現我的夢想。

patterns.zh: 從……起就一直……（現在完成式）
patterns.example: I have loved animals since I was a little child.
From then on, I wanted to help animals, too.
To get ready for this job, I study science hard at school.
I hope my dream will come true one day.

parts: The doctor took good care of him.
He got better in a week.
combine.answer: The doctor took good care of him, and he got better in a week.

parts: I want to get ready for this job.
combine.answer: To get ready for this job, I study science hard.

paraphrase.sentence: I want to be an animal doctor.
answers: I want to become a vet.
My dream is to be an animal doctor.
